description:
LAV Filters - Open-Source DirectShow Media Splitter and Decoders

LAV Filters are a set of DirectShow filters based on the libavformat and libavcodec libraries from the ffmpeg project, which will allow you to play virtually any format in a DirectShow player.
0.83.0 - 2026/08/17
LAV Splitter
- Fixed: Various stability improvements for Dolby Vision Enhancement Layer processing
- Fixed: Matroska files would only show the first 64 tracks
LAV Audio
- Fixed: Minor timing corrections for TrueHD Atmos bitstreaming
